code_note: all codes are strings of bits A B C (1 = contact closed), as params.DRUM.codes
rules: fw-base (c740e46) is the reference for behaviour; these are the drum's requirements.
Positive drum = N20 forward (DRV8833 #3 AIN1 high) = toward REEL = wrap direction.

Wiper stopped before drum moves, except: the fly-in into REEL (D41: creep forward over 318..340, stop on SW_DOG_R or +0.8 A, then jogs of at most 5 deg) and the unwrap (back to NEUTRAL with the wiper creeping forward for the bus take-up).

Check SW_DOG_L / SW_DOG_R during and after every move: LAUNCH needs DOG_L closed, REEL needs DOG_R closed, NEUTRAL / WRAP_PREP / WRAP / WRAPPED need both open; never enter the wrap window with either closed.
Dog not closed in LAUNCH: backward wiper wiggle within 40 deg / 6 s. Leaving LAUNCH or REEL under load: unload jog 6 deg (params unload_jog_deg), stopped early on a 0.8 A rise.

During every move: a code that is not the current or next zone -> stop, DRUM_SENSOR; an intermediate code must last 70 percent of span / dps; timeout 1.3 x nominal + 1 s -> DRUM_TIMEOUT; SW_ARM opening outside a wrap or unwrap -> fault. Contacts debounced 20 ms with chatter detection.
Fault in LAUNCH or L_TO_N: HOLD the drum unless SW_HOME is closed (spring not drawn), then NEUTRAL (D27).
Fault in NEUTRAL or WRAP_PREP: stop the wiper, hold.
Fault with the wraps on (WRAP, N_TO_R, REEL): the drum HOLDS (DRUM_HELD), never NEUTRAL; the operator unwraps when safe (REEL -> NEUTRAL with the take-up; there is no REEL -> WRAPPED command).
Boot: no automatic drum moves. Cross-check the code with DOG_L / DOG_R / SW_ARM and report a mismatch; the first commanded move re-references on a real code edge. Code 000 = DRUM_SENSOR.
SW_N20 open = hand fallback active: no drum moves. When it closes again, run the boot rules.
SW_INDEX: 6 pulses per wiper turn (degraded mode without the AS5600 magnet).
